items.title: Berlin Senate network hit by Rhysida ransomware
items.summary: Berlin's Senate network was reported hit by a ransomware attack attributed to the Rhysida group, per the ASEC September weekly dark-web roundup.

items.title: Canadian airline claimed by The Gentlemen ransomware
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline in early September; the airline's name was not confirmed in the sources reviewed.

items.title: AUDIT TEAM data-extortion campaign: South Korea, Germany, Argentina
items.summary: The AUDIT TEAM group conducted data-extortion attacks against four organizations across South Korea, Germany and Argentina.

items.title: 2026 ransomware volume: 7,551 victims, up 24.9%
items.summary: Black Kite's 2026 ransomware report counts 7,551 victims year to date, a 24.9% increase over the prior period.

ransomware.note: Search returned few fully named victims this run; several claims are group-attributed and not yet victim-confirmed.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down ChatGPT, Claude and Grok
items.summary: An Azure East US failure on Sept 3 knocked several major AI services offline at once for roughly 90 minutes, illustrating shared-dependency risk beneath the application layer.

items.title: Forrester: at least two multi-day hyperscaler outages expected in 2026
items.summary: Forrester predicts major multi-day outages at AWS, Azure or Google Cloud as providers prioritize AI infrastructure over legacy systems; 2026 has already seen prolonged AWS us-east-1 and Cloudflare incidents.

outage.note: As of Sept 17 no widespread cloud or internet outages were being reported; the Azure event is the only September incident found.

items.title: Cisco ISE zero-day under active exploitation; emergency patch issued
items.summary: Cisco released an emergency fix for an Identity Services Engine zero-day being actively exploited.

items.title: CISA adds seven exploited flaws to KEV (Sept 2)
items.summary: Additions include Sangoma Switchvox SQLi (CVE-2026-9586), Kludex Starlette request smuggling (CVE-2026-48710) and CVE-2026-49869, which Microsoft reports was used for reverse shells, cryptominer deployment and data harvesting.

items.title: Chromium V8 type-confusion flaw added to KEV (Sept 4)
items.summary: CISA added a Google Chromium V8 type-confusion vulnerability (CVE-2026-85046) on evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Two Windows zero-days added to KEV in September
items.summary: One of the two Windows zero-days had an EPSS score under 1% despite active exploitation, a reminder that EPSS-only prioritization can miss live threats.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake, 169 km W of Nikolski, Alaska (Sept 17)
items.summary: USGS significant event with a tsunami flag; PAGER alert level green.

items.title: M 6.4 earthquake, 49 km NNE of Kainantu, Papua New Guinea (Sept 20)
items.summary: USGS significant event; no tsunami flag, PAGER alert level green.

items.title: Grand Canyon flash-flood aftermath: water supply restoration under way
items.summary: After deadly late-August flash flooding, the last missing person was identified and NPS expects to restore reliable water supply within weeks.

items.title: Nepal flash floods (Aug 26) part of accelerating Himalayan disaster series
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal on Aug 26; included for continuity as the most recent Himalayan event surfaced.

physical.note: NASA EONET shows 7,772 natural events in 2026 to date (7,267 wildfires, 398 floods, 62 severe storms). No named September hurricane or typhoon surfaced in search; the two flood items pre-date the month.
